hadiths.arabicText: أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ ، عَنْ جَابِرُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ يُسَافَرَ بِالْقُرْآنِ إِلَى أَرْضِ الْعَدُوِّ , لِئَلا يَذْهَبُوا بِهِ فَيَنَالُوهُ " قَالَ الرَّبِيعُ : يَعْنِي بِالْقُرْآنِ هَاهُنَا الْمُصْحَفَ
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade traveling with the Quran to the land of the enemy, lest they take it and obtain it.

hadiths.arabicText: أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ ، عَنْ جَابِرُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ قَاعِدًا ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ مَعَ أَصْحَابِهِ إِذْ ذَكَرَ حَدِيثًا ، فَقَالَ : " ذَلِكَ أَوَانُ يُنْسَخُ الْقُرْآنُ " فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ كَالأَعْرَابِيِّ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، مَا النَّسْخُ ؟ وَكَيْفَ يُنْسَخُ ؟ ، قَالَ : " يُذْهَبُ بِأَهْلِهِ ، وَيَبْقَى رِجَالٌ كَأَنَّهُمُ الْبُغَاثُ " ، قَالَ الرَّبِيعُ : الْبُغَاثُ : أَرْذِلَةُ الطَّيْرِ
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Ibn 'Abbas from the Prophet ﷺ: He was sitting one day with his Companions when he mentioned a hadith, and said: 'That is the time when the Quran will be taken away.' A man like a Bedouin said: 'O Messenger of Allah, what is this taking away? And how will it be taken away?' He said: 'Its people will be taken, and there will remain men as if they are worthless birds.'

hadiths.arabicText: أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ ، قَالَ : بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ، رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ ، سَمِعَ هِشَامَ بْنَ حَكِيمٍ ، يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفُرْقَانِ عَلَى غَيْرِ قِرَاءَتِهِ هُوَ...
hadiths.english_translation: It reached me (balaghani) that 'Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, heard Hisham ibn Hakim reciting Surah al-Furqan in a manner different from his own recitation. 'Umar said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had taught it to me. So I grabbed him by his cloak and brought him to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: O Messenger of Allah, I heard this man reciting Surah al-Furqan differently from how you taught it to me. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to the man: 'Recite.' So he recited, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Thus it was revealed.' Then he said to me: 'Recite,' so I recited, and he said: 'Thus it was revealed. Indeed, this Quran was revealed in seven modes (ahruf), all of them healing and sufficient. So recite what is easy for you from it.'

potential_issues.impact: Severe impact - This makes the chain munqati' (disconnected) and the hadith cannot be graded as authentic through this chain alone. The narration requires corroboration from connected chains.

potential_issues.issue: Abu 'Ubaydah (d. ~150 AH) could not have met 'Umar ibn al-Khattab (d. 23 AH) - there is a generational gap of over 100 years.
potential_issues.impact: This confirms the disconnection - multiple generations are missing from the chain.

potential_issues.issue: The story of 'Umar and Hisham ibn Hakim is narrated in Sahih al-Bukhari and Muslim through connected chains from 'Umar himself, which strengthens the content but does not improve this particular chain.
potential_issues.impact: This specific chain remains problematic despite the narration being authentic through other routes.

Topics: Incident of 'Umar and Hisham ibn Hakim's different recitations
Prophetic teaching about Quranic variant readings

hadiths.arabicText: أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ ، قَالَ : بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا نَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ ، قَالَ : " اجْعَلُوهَا فِي سُورَةِ كَذَا وَكَذَا " ، وَمَا تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلا وَالْقُرْآنُ مَجْمُوعٌ مَتْلُوٌّ
hadiths.english_translation: It reached me (balaghani) that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when a verse was revealed to him, would say: 'Place it in such-and-such surah.' And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not pass away except that the Quran was compiled and recited.

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، قَالَ : " أُنْزِلَ الْقُرْآنُ كُلُّهُ جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا ، وَكَانَ اللَّهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُحْدِثَ فِي الأَرْضِ شَيْئًا أَنْزَلَ مِنْهُ حَتَّى جَمَعَهُ "
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Ibn 'Abbas from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who said: 'The entire Quran was sent down all at once on Laylat al-Qadr to the lowest heaven, and whenever Allah wanted to bring something new on earth, He would send down from it until He completed it.'

hadiths.arabicText: أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " تَعَلَّمُوا الْعِلْمَ ، فَإِنَّ تَعَلُّمَهُ قُرْبَةٌ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ، وَتَعْلِيمَهُ لِمَنْ لا يَعْلَمُهُ صَدَقَةٌ ، وَإِنَّ الْعِلْمَ لَيَنْزِلُ بِصَاحِبِهِ فِي مَوْضِعِ الشَّرَفِ وَالرِّفْعَةِ ، وَالْعِلْمُ زَيْنٌ لأَهْلِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ "
hadiths.english_translation: Jabir ibn Zayd said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Learn knowledge, for learning it is nearness to Allah Almighty, and teaching it to one who does not know it is charity. Indeed, knowledge places its possessor in a position of honor and elevation, and knowledge is an adornment for its people in this world and the Hereafter.'
